Summary

Fixes #14642.

```diff
 native argument parsing
   revalidate Pydantic models
   recursively parse lists
+  preserve existing custom-class instances (including subclasses)
   construct other values
```

This avoids constructor errors for two-field dataclasses and silent nesting for one-field dataclasses. Built-in coercion, dictionary construction and Pydantic revalidation stay intact.

## Evidence

- **Before:** 8 new public `Kernel.invoke` regression cases fail on main, covering ordinary/dataclass instances, subclasses, repeated calls, mixed lists and function-to-function values.
  **After:** `python -m pytest tests/unit/functions tests/unit/kernel` — 306 passed, 0 skipped on macOS/Python 3.12.
- Pydantic `revalidate_instances="always"`, invalid-instance rejection and built-in integer coercion remain covered.
- `pre-commit run --config python/.pre-commit-config.yaml --all-files` — all 13 hooks pass, including Ruff check/format. The repository-locked mypy 1.19.1 reports no issues in all 556 package source files.
- Existing deprecation/OpenAI cleanup warnings remain in the unit run; no model or service integration tests were run.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** argument-parsing

Limited to preserving custom instances already accepted by their parameter type; no API signatures or generic/union handling change.
